status: draft 0.2, a beta for review, written by gamma-ray@web-summit.dinis for Dinis Cruz; the rules below are ours and not those of any standard. An operation fact (logged, monitored and the like) counts only when it is observed or measured; the grant facts are read from a measured grant only.

freedom.name: Answers
freedom.agent: A question in, an answer out
freedom.rule: default when the agent is evidenced at all

freedom.name: Suggests
freedom.agent: Works with your data or tools and suggests actions
freedom.rule: I16, or I07 with one of I02 I03 I04 I05

freedom.name: Acts
freedom.rule: I08 and one of I17 I18 I19

freedom.name: Acts widely
freedom.agent: Acts across domains, code or external tools
freedom.rule: level 3 and one of I04 I10 I11

freedom.name: Coordinates
freedom.rule: level 4 and one of I12 I13, and one of I18 I19

governance.name: Unstated
governance.meaning: Nothing about how it is governed is evidenced

governance.name: Stated
governance.meaning: What it is for and the rules for it are written down
governance.rule: I20 and one of I34 I47

governance.name: Owned
governance.meaning: Somebody answers for it, a person can step in, and what it does is logged
governance.rule: level 1 and one of I30 I32, one of I38 I39, and I41 observed or measured

governance.name: Bounded
governance.meaning: Its grant is measured, every capability that cannot be undone is behind a boundary, and it is watched
governance.rule: level 2 and, from a measured grant, I23 and I45; and I43 observed or measured

governance.name: Proven
governance.meaning: Results are shown and somebody independent has checked
governance.rule: level 3 and I50, and one of I52 I63 I64
